cover.coreProposition: Executable configuration should have separate capabilities for code execution and ambient secret or host-resource authority: workspace trust can authorize a repository-controlled helper to run without implicitly authorizing inherited credentials, while credential-environment filtering is a least-authority control rather than a sandbox.
cover.visualMetaphor: A small machine is allowed through one gate while a separate locked vault keeps its keys out of reach
cover.semanticObject: One compact mechanical helper facing a distinct sealed key vault
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with two clearly separated physical objects, cool steel and emerald accents, restrained lighting and immediate thumbnail clarity
